title: The CI status reports workflows as running long after they finish
foundBy: repository owner, reading the CI dashboard: "The ledger, ui, lint, and sandbox projects all show their CI status as running, even though they completed."
details:
`pages.yml` writes `ci-status.json` when ci finishes, and publish images starts at that same moment. The file is written within half a minute, so it records that run as in progress. Nothing rewrites it until the next push, so the dashboard at codesweep.ai/dashboards/ci shows this repository as running from then on.

On 135d9d4, ci finished at 20:28:27, and pages and publish images both started two seconds later. The file was generated at 20:28:54, and publish images finished at 20:31:23. The status action leaves out only the run writing the file, so publish images is reported as unfinished.

base-images can do the same. A push that changes the images starts it beside ci, and it can outlast ci. On bea6812, pushed on 2026-09-07, ci finished at 22:09:05 and base-images at 22:10:56. A status written on ci's completion would have recorded base-images as unfinished.

It began when publish images moved out of ci into a workflow of its own, in 601626e. The comment in `pages.yml` expected such a run to be a few minutes behind. It is reported as running instead, until the next push repeats the same race.
